regions.region: title, abstract, DOI, authors, and ESI notice
regions.finding: Article metadata were confirmed visually. The paper advertises ESI, but no SI file was supplied or associated.
Conceptual overview of cited γ-addition and α-addition/twofold-addition modes. These are generic literature families, not concrete current-paper experiments.
Current-work generic (4+1) annulation design and proposed intermediates; represented as one generic scheme, not an executed experiment.

unresolved: Scheme 1a groups broad cited precedents and does not provide concrete substrate-specific conditions or yields.
Proposed intermediates in Scheme 1b are not experimentally isolated records.

regions.region: Table 1, all ten printed data rows and footnotes a–b
regions.finding: Ten distinct optimization experiments were inventoried. The table visibly repeats entry number 4; the anisylphosphine optimum is the second printed entry 4, while prose calls it entry 5. All table yields use the isolated-yield footnote.
All 19 scope outcomes were inventoried. Product 3a duplicates the optimized anisylphosphine 71% Table 1 experiment and was merged with it; products 3b–3s are 18 additional experiments.

regions.region: scope discussion below Scheme 2 and lower-right continuation
regions.finding: Prose confirms the substrate series, yields for selected products, and the distinct N-acylpyrazole outcome 4; it does not state a common yield measurement basis for Scheme 2 or Scheme 3.

unresolved: Scheme 2 and Scheme 3 do not state yield measurement methods on this page.
Most scope absolute charges, solvent volume, atmosphere, workup, and purification are unavailable because SI was not supplied.
Compact product structures lack explicit absolute-configuration and alkene-geometry assignments.

regions.finding: One concrete N-acylpyrazole/allenoate experiment gives product 4 in 30%; mechanistic intermediates E/F and the pathway discussion are not separate experiments.
Two distinct PtBu3-catalysed experiments were recorded because Na2CO3 and NaOH give separate 27% and 69% product-5 outcomes.
Author-proposed mechanism with paths to 3a and 5; retained as one proposed-mechanism record, not a collection of executed intermediate reactions.
Two concrete experiments: 1.0 mmol scale annulation to 3g (0.28 g, 57%) and a separate intramolecular Heck conversion of 3g to 6 (73%).

unresolved: Scheme-level yields do not report measurement bases.
Equation (1), Scheme 3, and Scheme 5 omit workup and purification details on the covered pages.
The discussion mentions the no-phosphine control, but its detailed conditions are only incompletely described in footnote 12.

regions.finding: Bibliography only; cited papers were not imported as current-paper experiments.
A real negative mechanistic control states that reaction of 1a and 2 without phosphine catalyst gave no detectable product 5. The footnote does not specify which base variant or the detection method.
No current synthesis arrow, optimization table, standalone mass-spectrum peak table, molecular-weight table, or fragment-relative-abundance block is present beyond the footnote control.

unresolved: The no-phosphine control's base, scale, temperature, time, atmosphere, and detection method are unreported in footnote 12 and were not inferred.
